svg.title: Synthetic scene comparison: 400 metre and 1 kilometre square maps
svg.desc: The same deterministic synthetic scene is clipped to two extents at a shared origin. The 400 metre square has 20 buildings; the 1 kilometre square has 97. Blue-grey means a synthetic GIS-height fixture, teal means a synthetic verified-ledger fixture, and orange means unknown height. A dashed square on the larger map marks the smaller extent. These are test data, not actual Gangnam buildings. North is up. Coordinates are local metres.
svg.text: Actual demo footprints · common origin · local metric coordinates
Same building IDs, heights and footprints at both scales. Courtyards and missing-height footprints are preserved.
